Remark
[Compactness suffices in Claim 1] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0208 ↗ clm:chow-iii-point-picking-claim-one 1. ch22:22.4\group Point picking

The proof of Claim 1 only needs compactness of the closed balls $\overline B_{g(t)}(x_0,(2A+1)\epsilon _0)$ for each time, rather than global completeness.
